about.title: About Raadraac
about.description: Raadraac is an app designed to help preserve and share Somali cultural heritage through technology. By recognizing traditional objects, we hope to connect people with the rich history and craftsmanship of Somalia.
about.step1: Upload or take a photo of a traditional object
about.step3: Learn about the object's history, use, and cultural significance
about.offline: Works offline! Download the app to use it anywhere.
